holes.verdict: wrong hole line (router) + wrong tee position
holes.notes: rv14 (2026-11-02): the published page (build 12:02) was right: OSM way/1565676856 tee -> NE over the cart path -> fairway bend -> N to the green, 373 yds, Blue 400 / White 366 measured. Later builds (packages 15:34 and 17:02, the mapper's base) dropped that way: it is inside_course false and a neighbouring course's hole-10 way duplicates ref 10, so sanity.select_hole_ways removed both and routing/2 re-routed 10 from lidar pad lidar:129 by the 1st tee, straight north through the woods and over the 18th green (mapper: 'corridor through woods, past a building'; 336/305/223 measured from the OSM boxes; the 17:02 build then put the tees on lidar pads / walkback in the woods to hit the card). Fix: osm_supplement.geojson carries the OSM line as a hand hole (wins by ref, never dropped). Tees: along that line the OSM boxes are blue-tag 365-380, white-tag 316-344, red-tag 230; card 405/371/329, so the colour tags are one box short (as on 3, 12, 13): White on the blue-tag box, Red on the white-tag box, Blue 25 yds behind the blue box in the mown strip by the park road (no OSM box; the 12:02 build's Blue point, 400 measured). The red-tag box (230) is a forward tee.
